key_insight: MindTopo shows that foundation models can recognize some topological relations in static reasoning, but they struggle much more when they must act as closed-loop agents that preserve topology over time.
engineering_relevance: For robotics, simulation, and spatial AI, the benchmark highlights a gap between visual pattern recognition and reliable topology-aware planning under environment dynamics.
method: Created MindTopo, a benchmark of 11,030 procedurally generated instances across 13 task types.
Covers five topology properties from cognitive science and formal topology: continuity, separation, order, enclosure, and knots.
Evaluates each property at two levels: reasoning and planning, with controllable difficulty.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports benchmarking 14 MLLMs and finding that every model performed better on reasoning than planning, with the best model still far below human performance.
watch_item: Generated observations may look plausible locally but can fail to follow true environment dynamics or preserve topology across transitions, limiting reliability in agent settings.
paper_title: MindTopo: Can Foundation Models Reason in Topological Space?
